coverage.case: Approval binds frozen oracle and baseline bytes; stale receipts and changed baseline reject before write/engine start
Native Godot script/scene/resource fixed wrong candidate restores exact originals; different correct candidate commits under unchanged oracle
Identical candidate ID or edit content rejects; absent/new IDs, reordered files and changed source/rationale do not consume another budget or write
Same-session status, cancellation before write, and real COMMITTED result survive explicit delivery failure; source snapshots released on close
Lost client submit response produces UNKNOWN with IDs and retryable=false; no automatic resubmission
Existing semantic rename/native validation and strict editor LSP listener ownership; malformed owner data fail closed

proofBoundary: Official MCP SDK fixtures and native Godot are real. Approval, transport loss and delivery faults are explicitly controlled test doubles, not installed Codex/Cursor or human approval UX.
